v5.10.26 - Auto-Abandon mid-run start fix
Fixed ----- - Auto-Abandon no longer instantly stops a run when the bot is started mid-career. On start the rank projection resets, so a mid-run launch had a single data point, making the projection flat at the current (still sub-target) score and triggering an immediate false abandon. Auto-Abandon now waits until it has enough per-turn history to judge a real trajectory before it can stop a run; full runs started from the beginning are unaffected.
